SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_no, e.emp_name, e.dept_id, e.position_id, e.email, e.hire_date, e.role, e.use_yn, d.dept_name, p.position_name, p.position_level FROM employee e JOIN department d ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id JOIN position p ON p.position_id = e.position_id
ORDER BY p.position_level DESC, e.hire_date, e.emp_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT e.emp_id, e.emp_no, e.emp_name, e.dept_id, e.position_id, e.email, e.hire_date, e.password_hash, e.role, e.use_yn, d.dept_name, p.position_name, p.position_level FROM employee e JOIN department d ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id JOIN position p ON p.position_id = e.position_id WHERE e.emp_no = #{empNo}
